tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I didn't send any payment, because Fjord Analytics (vendor V-410) has two approved invoices and you asked me to pay one:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-30103 | $4,332.36 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-50292 | $5,384.89 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

Two other invoices aren't payable: INV-59460 ($4,391.78) is already paid, and INV-91213 ($7,010.11) is still a draft waiting for approval. The operating account shows no payments sent yet, so nothing has gone out to this vendor in this session.

Please tell me which invoice to pay, or whether to pay both. I'll send it by wire, or by ACH if wire isn't available, with an idempotency key so it's paid only once. Both amounts are under $10,000, so neither needs the controller's approval.

trace.message: Pay INV-50292, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-50292, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Fjord Analytics invoice INV-50292 in full by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-50292 (due 2026-11-25)
- **Amount:** $5,384.89
- **Method:** wire
- **Status:** sent

The operating account's payment list shows only this one payment, so it went out once. I used a unique request key, so a repeat of the same request can't charge twice. The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval. I left INV-30103 ($4,332.36) unpaid because it's under dispute.
